name: Pocket Mochi Export
changes: The presets Pro notice now says that presets are a Pro feature.
The folder export Pro notices now write Pro with a capital P.
tip: Put an empty line above the --- marker so the card back looks like normal text in Obsidian.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pocket Mochi Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to move your cards into Mochi.
